docs.title: ign8mail
docs.text:
Ignite a production-grade mail server in minutes.

ign8mail is a single-command Python CLI that provisions a complete, working mail server from scratch — VM, DNS, TLS, and mail stack all wired together.

docs.title: What it does in one command
docs.text:
1. Generates an SSH keypair (and a DKIM keypair) into .ign8mail/keys/.
  2. Provisions a Hetzner Cloud VPS via the hcloud SDK — server, firewall, SSH key.
  3. Creates all required Cloudflare DNS records — A, AAAA, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, autoconfig/autodiscover.
  4. SSHs into the server and installs + configures Postfix, Dovecot, rspamd, and a Let's Encrypt certificate via certbot.

After ign8mail up returns, you have a working mail server with TLS, DKIM signing, SPF, DMARC, and IMAPS/SMTPS reachable on mail.<domain>.

docs.title: Backend stack
docs.text: Component Role Postfix SMTP MTA (incoming on 25, submission on 587, SMTPS on 465) Dovecot IMAP server (IMAPS on 993) and SASL auth backend rspamd Spam filtering and DKIM signing certbot Let's Encrypt TLS certificates Hetzner Cloud VPS host (Ubuntu 24.04, default cx23 in nbg1) Cloudflare DNS provider

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install ign8mail
# or
pipx install ign8mail

docs.title: Next steps
docs.text:
• Quickstart — your first mail server in five minutes.
  • Cooperative webmail — share support@, sales@ etc. across the team; keep <username>@ personal.
  • Architecture — what gets provisioned and where state lives.
  • CLI reference — every command and flag.
  • DNS records — exactly which records get created.
  • Configuration — all IGN8_-prefixed env vars.
  • Operations — day-2 tasks: backup, destroy, mailbox management, TUI reader.

docs.title: The four-step provisioning flow
docs.text:
ign8mail up
    │
    ├─▶ 1. keys.save_keypair()           ──▶ .ign8mail/keys/
    │      RSA SSH + DKIM keypairs
    │
    ├─▶ 2. infra.hetzner.build()         ──▶ Hetzner Cloud
    │      Server + Firewall + SshKey
    │      (hcloud SDK, no Pulumi.yaml)
    │
    ├─▶ 3. dns.cloudflare.provision()    ──▶ Cloudflare API
    │      A, AAAA, MX, SPF, DKIM,
    │      DMARC, autoconfig, autodiscover
    │
    └─▶ 4. mailserver.setup.MailServerSetup
           SSH into the server, apt install,
           configure Postfix + Dovecot + rspamd,
           run certbot for TLS

Each step is independent and idempotent — re-running up against an existing server reconciles state rather than re-creating it.

docs.title: Source layout
docs.text:
src/ign8mail/
├── cli.py            # Typer app; orchestrates the 4-step flow
├── config.py         # Pydantic-settings Config; env prefix IGN8_; reads .env
├── keys.py           # RSA keypair generation (SSH + DKIM)
├── vault.py          # Ansible-vault-encrypted mailbox secret store
├── infra/
│   └── hetzner.py    # hcloud SDK: Server + Firewall + SshKey
├── dns/
│   └── cloudflare.py # CloudflareDNS.provision() — creates all records
├── mailserver/
│   └── setup.py      # MailServerSetup: SSH, apt, postfix/dovecot, certbot
├── tui/              # Textual-based multi-account mail reader
│   ├── app.py
│   ├── client.py
│   └── newmail.py
├── webmail/          # Optional Django webmail UI
└── thunderbird.py    # Thunderbird profile sync helpers

docs.title: The Hetzner VM
docs.text: Setting Default Override Server type cx23 IGN8_SERVER_TYPE Image ubuntu-24.04 IGN8_SERVER_IMAGE Location nbg1 IGN8_SERVER_LOCATION Firewall name ign8mail-fw —

docs.title: Firewall rules
docs.text:
Inbound TCP allowed on:

Port Service 22 SSH 25 SMTP (MTA-to-MTA) 80 HTTP (Let's Encrypt + landing page) 443 HTTPS (landing page + webmail) 465 SMTPS (submission over implicit TLS) 587 SMTP submission with STARTTLS 993 IMAPS

All other inbound traffic is dropped. Outbound traffic is unrestricted.

docs.title: Mail stack on the server
docs.text: Component Role Postfix SMTP. Smtpd-tls-cert from Let's Encrypt, sasl auth via Dovecot Dovecot IMAP, Maildir-format storage under /home/<user>/Maildir, also SASL auth backend for Postfix rspamd Spam scoring + DKIM signing (selector mail2) certbot TLS certificates, auto-renewed Linux users Each mailbox is a real PAM user. Passwords are stored in the vault and on the system

docs.title: State and secrets
docs.text:
Everything lives under .ign8mail/ in the directory you ran ign8mail up from:

.ign8mail/
├── keys/
│   ├── id_rsa           # SSH private key (mode 0600)
│   ├── id_rsa.pub       # SSH public key (uploaded to Hetzner)
│   ├── dkim.private     # DKIM private key (uploaded to server)
│   └── dkim.public.txt  # DKIM public key (embedded in TXT record)
├── vault.yml            # Ansible-vault-encrypted mailbox passwords
└── state.json           # Server IDs, IP addresses, last-applied config

Treat .ign8mail/ as secret

It contains private keys and mailbox credentials. Back it up, but never commit it.

docs.title: DNS
docs.text: All DNS records are created in Cloudflare via the Python SDK in a single call to CloudflareDNS.provision(). See the DNS records page for the exact set.

docs.title: CLI reference
docs.text: All commands accept --help for full flag listings. This page summarises every command grouped by purpose.

docs.title: ign8mail up
docs.text:
Provision a complete mail server: Hetzner VM + Cloudflare DNS + Postfix/Dovecot.

ign8mail up \
  --domain example.com \
  --admin-email admin@example.com \
  --hetzner-token $IGN8_HETZNER_TOKEN \
  --cloudflare-token $IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN \
  --cloudflare-zone-id $IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID

Idempotent — safe to re-run.

docs.title: ign8mail destroy
docs.text: Tear down the Hetzner server, saving a backup first. DNS records are left intact.

docs.title: ign8mail backup
docs.text: Snapshot server state (users, config) to backup.json without touching the server.

docs.title: ign8mail status
docs.text:
Show the current state of the provisioned mail server.

ign8mail status --check-services        # SSH in, verify postfix/dovecot/rspamd
ign8mail status --check-mail            # Send a probe email and verify IMAP delivery
ign8mail status --format json

docs.title: ign8mail create-mailbox <name>
docs.text: Create a mailbox on the running server. Generates a password and stores it in the vault.

docs.title: ign8mail delete-mailbox <name>
docs.text: Delete a mailbox. Use --purge to also remove the home directory and all mail.

docs.title: ign8mail adduser <username>
docs.text: Create a mail user (lower-level alternative to create-mailbox).

docs.title: ign8mail list
docs.text: List known mail inboxes on the running server.

docs.title: ign8mail list-new
docs.text: Show new (unread) mail across every mailbox, then open the reader TUI. Use --no-tui for a static table.

docs.title: ign8mail show-passwords
docs.text: Print every mailbox password from the vault.

docs.title: ign8mail passwd-check
docs.text: Probe IMAP login for every account in the vault. Non-destructive.

docs.title: ign8mail passwd-recycle
docs.text: Reset all mail account passwords and rewrite per-mailbox ~/.mbsync.<user> profiles.

docs.title: ign8mail read [account]
docs.text: Open the multi-account TUI reader. Optionally pass an account to focus on launch.

docs.title: ign8mail webmail
docs.text: Start the bundled Django webmail interface on localhost:8000.

docs.title: ign8mail switch-inbox <account>
docs.text: Switch local mbsync/neomutt/msmtp configs to point at a different mailbox.

docs.title: ign8mail tail-postfix-log
docs.text: Stream the Postfix log from the running server.

docs.title: ign8mail configure-thunderbird <username>
docs.text: Add an IMAP/SMTP account to your local Thunderbird profile.

docs.title: ign8mail sync-thunderbird
docs.text: Add all active mailboxes to Thunderbird and store their passwords.

docs.title: ign8mail sync-aerc
docs.text: Add all active mailboxes to aerc's accounts.conf.

docs.title: Cooperative webmail
docs.text: See Cooperative webmail for the full model.

docs.title: ign8mail user-add <username> [-p <address>]
docs.text: Register username as a webmail user. --personal/-p is repeatable; default is <username>@<domain>.

docs.title: ign8mail configure-sharing
docs.text: Push smtpd_sender_login_maps to the server and turn on reject_sender_login_mismatch on submission (port 587). Re-run after changing users: in the vault.

docs.title: ign8mail configure-nginx
docs.text: Deploy the landing page and configure nginx on the running server.

docs.title: ign8mail configure-dkim
docs.text: Upload the DKIM key and configure rspamd signing.

docs.title: ign8mail deploy-webmail
docs.text: Deploy the webmail interface to webmail.<domain> via Cloudflare proxy.

docs.title: ign8mail enable-autocreate
docs.text: Deploy the autocreate policy daemon — accept mail for unknown local-parts and create mailboxes on demand.

docs.title: ign8mail seed
docs.text: Send a seed email to each address in mailboxes.yml so the autocreate daemon provisions them.

docs.title: Auto-created mailboxes
docs.text:
ign8mail autocreated — manage mailboxes created on-the-fly by the autocreate daemon.

Subcommand Purpose autocreated list List auto-created mailboxes and their status autocreated sync Pull new auto-created mailboxes into the vault autocreated enable <name> Mark mailbox as kept autocreated disable <name> Stop accepting new mail (existing mail kept) autocreated silence <name> Delete mailbox and block future creation

docs.title: ign8mail dmarc-stats
docs.text:
Fetch and display DMARC aggregate report statistics.

ign8mail dmarc-stats --delete   # also delete parsed report emails

docs.title: ign8mail vault-init
docs.text: Create .ign8mail/vault.yml from current IGN8_* environment variables.

docs.title: ign8mail ssh
docs.text: Open an interactive SSH session to the provisioned server.

docs.title: ign8mail checkmail --mail-user <user>
docs.text: Send a test email and verify IMAP delivery for a single mailbox. Use --fix to attempt repairs.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: All settings come from a single Config (pydantic-settings) object. Values can be supplied via CLI flags, environment variables, or a .env file in the working directory.

docs.title: Required
docs.text: Env var CLI flag Description IGN8_DOMAIN --domain Your mail domain, e.g. example.com (no trailing dot) IGN8_ADMIN_EMAIL --admin-email Admin / certbot notification email IGN8_HETZNER_TOKEN --hetzner-token Hetzner Cloud API token (project-scoped) IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_TOKENor IGN8_CLOUDFLARE --cloudflare-token Cloudflare API Token (or Global API Key) IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID --cloudflare-zone-id Cloudflare Zone ID for the domain

docs.title: Cloudflare auth flavour
docs.text: Env var When to set IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL Set only when using a Global API Key. Leave unset for API Tokens.

docs.title: Server (Hetzner)
docs.text: Env var Default Description IGN8_SERVER_LOCATION nbg1 Datacenter — one of nbg1 (Nuremberg), fsn1 (Falkenstein), hel1 (Helsinki), etc. IGN8_SERVER_TYPE cx23 Hetzner server type. cx23 is a 2 vCPU / 8 GB tier well-suited to single-domain mail. IGN8_SERVER_IMAGE ubuntu-24.04 OS image

docs.title: Mail limits
docs.text: Env var Default Description IGN8_MAILBOX_QUOTA_MB 2048 Per-mailbox Dovecot quota (MB) IGN8_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_MB 50 Postfix message_size_limit (MB)

docs.title: Vault & state
docs.text: Env var Default Description IGN8_VAULT .ign8mail/vault.yml Ansible-vault file with mailbox passwords IGN8_MAIL_PASSWORD — Per-command password override (used by read, checkmail, switch-inbox) IGN8_WEBMAIL_PASSWORD — Webmail admin password

docs.title: .env example
docs.text:
.env
# --- Required ---
IGN8_DOMAIN=example.com
IGN8_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com
IGN8_HETZNER_TOKEN=hetzner_xxx
IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN=cf_token_xxx
IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID=abcdef0123456789

# --- Optional (defaults shown) ---
IGN8_SERVER_LOCATION=nbg1
IGN8_SERVER_TYPE=cx23
IGN8_SERVER_IMAGE=ubuntu-24.04
IGN8_MAILBOX_QUOTA_MB=2048
IGN8_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_MB=50

docs.title: Precedence
docs.text:
For any setting, the resolution order is:

  1. CLI flag (e.g. --domain example.com)
  2. Environment variable (e.g. IGN8_DOMAIN=example.com)
  3. .env file in the current working directory
  4. Default value (from config.py)

The domain is normalised — trailing dots are stripped automatically.

docs.title: DNS records
docs.text: CloudflareDNS.provision() creates every record needed for production mail in one call. All records are created in the Cloudflare zone identified by IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID.

docs.title: Records created
docs.text:
Type Name Content Proxied A mail.<domain> server IPv4 no AAAA mail.<domain> server IPv6 no MX <domain> mail.<domain> (priority 10) n/a TXT (SPF) <domain> v=spf1 mx a:<ipv4> ~all n/a TXT (DKIM) mail2._domainkey.<domain> v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=<public-key> n/a TXT (DMARC) _dmarc.<domain> v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@<domain> n/a CNAME autoconfig.<domain> mail.<domain> no CNAME autodiscover.<domain> mail.<domain> no

DKIM selector

The selector is mail2 (not mail) — the change was made in v2.3.0. If you rotate keys, the old mail._domainkey.<domain> record is left untouched.

Cloudflare proxy

Mail records (mail.<domain>, autoconfig CNAMEs) are never proxied — Cloudflare does not proxy SMTP/IMAP and would break TLS. SPF/DKIM/DMARC are TXT records and aren't proxyable to begin with.

docs.title: DMARC policy
docs.text: The default policy is p=quarantine with aggregate reports sent to dmarc@<domain>. To tighten to p=reject, edit the record manually in Cloudflare after provisioning — ign8mail will not overwrite it on re-runs unless you delete it first.

docs.title: Aggregate report ingestion
docs.text:
DMARC report mail arrives at dmarc@<domain>. Read it with:

ign8mail dmarc-stats
ign8mail dmarc-stats --delete   # consume after parsing

docs.title: What ign8mail does not create
docs.text:
• PTR (reverse DNS) — Hetzner sets PTR on the VM, but you need to set it to mail.<domain> via the Hetzner Cloud console. Without it, big mail providers will downgrade your reputation.
  • MTA-STS / TLSRPT — not provisioned.
  • BIMI — not provisioned.

docs.title: Adding webmail DNS
docs.text:
ign8mail deploy-webmail adds an additional record:

Type Name Content Proxied A or CNAME webmail.<domain> server IPv4 yes (Cloudflare-proxied)

docs.title: Operations
docs.text: Day-2 tasks for a running ign8mail server.

docs.title: Creating and managing mailboxes
docs.text:
# Create
ign8mail create-mailbox alice

# List
ign8mail list

# Delete (keeps mail data)
ign8mail delete-mailbox alice

# Delete and wipe Maildir
ign8mail delete-mailbox alice --purge

Every mailbox is a real PAM user on the server. Passwords are generated, stored in .ign8mail/vault.yml (Ansible-vault encrypted), and printed once on creation.

docs.title: TUI reader (built-in)
docs.text:
ign8mail read              # multi-account TUI, all mailboxes
ign8mail read alice        # open with alice focused
ign8mail list-new          # show unread across every mailbox, then drop into the reader

Key bindings: open the help overlay with ? once inside the TUI.

docs.title: Webmail
docs.text:
ign8mail webmail           # serve on http://localhost:8000
ign8mail deploy-webmail    # deploy as webmail.<domain> via Cloudflare

docs.title: Thunderbird
docs.text:
ign8mail configure-thunderbird alice    # add one account
ign8mail sync-thunderbird               # add every active mailbox

docs.title: aerc / neomutt + mbsync + msmtp
docs.text:
ign8mail sync-aerc                      # write accounts.conf entries
ign8mail switch-inbox alice             # rewrite ~/.mbsyncrc and ~/.msmtprc

docs.title: Backups
docs.text:
ign8mail backup            # writes backup.json without touching the server

backup.json captures user list, vault, and resolved config. It does not snapshot Maildirs — for that, use restic or Hetzner snapshots.

ign8mail destroy runs a backup automatically before deleting the server.

docs.title: Health checks
docs.text:
ign8mail status                              # local view of state.json
ign8mail status --check-services             # SSH in, verify postfix/dovecot/rspamd
ign8mail status --check-mail \
        --mail-user alice                    # send test mail + verify IMAP receipt
ign8mail status --format json                # machine-readable

For a single mailbox:

ign8mail checkmail --mail-user alice
ign8mail checkmail --mail-user alice --fix   # attempt to fix missing maildir, etc.

docs.title: Password ops
docs.text:
ign8mail show-passwords     # print every mailbox password from the vault
ign8mail passwd-check       # parallel IMAP login probe against every account
ign8mail passwd-recycle     # rotate every password and rewrite mbsync profiles

Server rebuild = vault drift

If you rebuild the Hetzner VM out-of-band, vault passwords no longer match the server's /etc/shadow. passwd-check will report every account as failed. Fix by running passwd-recycle or recreating mailboxes from the vault.

docs.title: DMARC reports
docs.text:
ign8mail dmarc-stats                # parse and display aggregate reports
ign8mail dmarc-stats --delete       # consume reports after parsing

docs.title: Logs
docs.text:
ign8mail tail-postfix-log           # stream /var/log/mail.log
ign8mail tail-postfix-log --no-follow --log /var/log/mail.err

docs.title: SSH
docs.text:
ign8mail ssh                # interactive shell as root
ign8mail ssh --user alice   # connect as a non-root user

docs.title: Autocreated mailboxes
docs.text:
When the autocreate daemon is deployed (ign8mail enable-autocreate), any mail to an unknown local-part provisions a mailbox on demand.

ign8mail autocreated list           # see what was created automatically
ign8mail autocreated sync           # pull new ones into the vault
ign8mail autocreated enable bob     # promote auto-created to "kept"
ign8mail autocreated disable bob    # stop accepting new mail (keep existing)
ign8mail autocreated silence bob    # delete and blocklist future creation

docs.title: Tear down
docs.text:
ign8mail destroy
  • Runs backup first.
  • Deletes the Hetzner server and firewall.
  • Leaves DNS records, the local .ign8mail/ directory, and the vault untouched — so re-running ign8mail up reuses the same keys and DNS without propagation delay.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text: From zero to a fully provisioned mail server in three steps.

docs.title: 1. Prerequisites
docs.text:
You'll need:

  • Python 3.11+
  • A Hetzner Cloud account with a project-scoped API token
  • A domain whose DNS is managed by Cloudflare, plus:
    • An API Token with Zone.DNS:Edit scope (recommended), or a Global API Key
    • The Zone ID for that domain

docs.title: 2. Install
docs.text:
pipx install ign8mail

Or for a normal venv:

pip install ign8mail

docs.title: 3. Configure
docs.text:
Create a .env in the directory you want state and keys to live in:

.env
IGN8_DOMAIN=example.com
IGN8_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com
IGN8_HETZNER_TOKEN=hetzner_xxx
IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN=cf_xxx
IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID=abcdef0123456789

API Token vs Global API Key

If you use a Cloudflare API Token (recommended), leave IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL unset. If you use the Global API Key, also set IGN8_CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL=you@example.com.

docs.title: 4. Ignite
docs.text:
ign8mail up

Expect the run to take 3–5 minutes. The CLI prints progress for each phase:

  1. SSH + DKIM keypair generation
  2. Hetzner VM + firewall provisioning
  3. Cloudflare DNS records
  4. SSH-driven install + configuration of Postfix, Dovecot, rspamd, certbot

When it finishes, your mail server is reachable on mail.<your-domain>.

docs.title: 5. Add a mailbox
docs.text:
ign8mail create-mailbox alice

The password is generated, stored in .ign8mail/vault.yml, and printed once.

docs.title: 6. Read mail
docs.text:
The bundled TUI reader:

ign8mail read              # all accounts
ign8mail list-new          # show unread across every mailbox, then open the reader

Or wire it into Thunderbird / aerc / neomutt — see Operations.

docs.title: 7. Tear down
docs.text:
ign8mail destroy

Removes the Hetzner server. DNS records are left intact so you can re-provision without DNS propagation delay.

docs.title: Cooperative webmail
docs.text: ign8mail's webmail treats your domain as a single shared workspace. Anyone with an account can read every non-personal mailbox in mailbox_passwords — perfect for support@, sales@, info@-style addresses that the whole team handles together. Each user's <username>@<domain> (and any extra addresses they claim) stays 100% private.

docs.title: The model
docs.text: Concept Behavior Personal mailbox Listed in a user's personal_addresses. Only that user can read it or send from it. Shared mailbox Everything else in mailbox_passwords. Visible and writable to all registered users. Unified inbox The home page is a single time-ordered stream of every mailbox the logged-in user can see, with a mailbox-tag on each row. Per-user read state Reading a shared message marks it seen for you only (SQLite overlay). Others still see it as unread. Personal mailboxes use Dovecot's \Seen flag normally. Send-as enforcement Postfix smtpd_sender_login_maps rejects any submission where the SASL login isn't allowed to use the From address. A leaked password cannot impersonate anyone else's personal address.

docs.title: 1. Create mailboxes
docs.text:
Same as before — one mailbox per address:

ign8mail create-mailbox jakob       # will become personal
ign8mail create-mailbox alice       # will become personal
ign8mail create-mailbox support     # will stay shared
ign8mail create-mailbox sales       # will stay shared

docs.title: 2. Register users
docs.text:
Declare which addresses are personal-to-whom:

ign8mail user-add jakob                              # personal = jakob@<domain>
ign8mail user-add jakob -p jakob@jakobholst.dk \
                         -p lyngknuden@jakobholst.dk # multiple personal addresses
ign8mail user-add alice                              # personal = alice@<domain>

Anyone with a mailbox_passwords entry but no users entry is treated as a shared mailbox automatically.

docs.title: 3. Push send-as enforcement to the server
docs.text:
ign8mail configure-sharing

This generates /etc/postfix/sender_login_maps and rewrites the submission block in /etc/postfix/master.cf to require reject_sender_login_mismatch. Port 25 (MTA-to-MTA) is untouched so external mail keeps arriving.

docs.title: 4. Start the webmail
docs.text:
ign8mail webmail

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000. Log in with your IMAP username + password.

docs.title: What each user sees
docs.text:
For a vault where:

mailbox_passwords:
  jakob: ...
  alice: ...
  support: ...
  sales: ...
users:
  jakob:
    personal_addresses: [jakob@jakobholst.dk, lyngknuden@jakobholst.dk]
  alice:
    personal_addresses: [alice@jakobholst.dk]
Jakob sees Alice sees Sidebar jakob 🔥, lyngknuden 🔥, support 💬, sales 💬 alice 🔥, support 💬, sales 💬 Can read All four Three (cannot see jakob/lyngknuden) Can send from jakob@, lyngknuden@, support@, sales@ alice@, support@, sales@ Default From jakob@jakobholst.dk alice@jakobholst.dk

🔥 = personal · 💬 = shared

docs.title: Sharing & disabling addresses
docs.text:
Because shared mailboxes are real PAM users on the server with their own Maildir, you can hand out a shared address (e.g. for a one-off project), monitor it in the unified inbox, and revoke it cleanly if it gets spammed:

# From the webmail mailbox view, click "Disable" or "Silence" on a shared mailbox.
# CLI equivalent:
ign8mail autocreated disable spam-magnet
ign8mail autocreated silence spam-magnet   # also delete the maildir + blocklist

Personal mailboxes never expose the Disable/Silence actions in the UI.

docs.title: Compose
docs.text: Hit ＋ Compose in the top bar. From-dropdown lists exactly the addresses Postfix will accept from you — your personal addresses plus every shared one. The message is submitted via Postfix on port 587 with STARTTLS, authenticated with your own SASL credentials. sender_login_maps is the final authority: if you try to forge an address you're not allowed to use, Postfix rejects the message.

docs.title: Read-state overlay
docs.text:
~/.ign8mail/seen.db is a small SQLite file tracking (user, mailbox, uid, seen_at) for shared mailboxes. Nothing leaks to other users; Dovecot's \Seen flag is never set on shared messages from webmail traffic, so simultaneous clients (Thunderbird, etc.) keep seeing them as unread until they actually read them.

Personal mailboxes bypass the overlay and use Dovecot's flag directly — same behavior as a regular IMAP client.

docs.title: Limitations
docs.text:
• Webmail only. Thunderbird/aerc users log in to their own IMAP account and see only that mailbox. To get shared access for desktop clients you'd need Dovecot ACL / shared namespaces — not provisioned by ign8mail.
  • Per-user read state lives on the webmail host. Don't run two ign8mail webmail instances on different machines — they would diverge.
  • Compose has no attachments yet. Plain-text body only.
